entities.summary: David IV, a notable figure in the history of Georgia, associated with Golden Age of Georgia (1089–1125). Preceded by Georgian Architectural Golden Age and Gelati Monastery. Their legacy influenced Battle of Didgori — decisive Georgian victory over the Seljuks and David the Builder liberates Tbilisi from the Arab emirate.
